description: Department of Transportation Inventory of Artificial Intelligence Use Cases is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Administrative", published or maintained by US Department of Transportation. This dataset is a list of Department of Transportation (DOT) Artificial Intelligence (AI) use cases. The Advancing American AI Act, Executive Order (EO) 13960, Promoting the Use of Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in the Federal Government, and Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Memorandum M-25-21, Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust ... Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Administrative". It has 35 columns, among them Benefit Description, Output Description, Operation Date, Vendor Name, ATO Indicator, PII Indicator. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last data update. Attribution given: US Department of Transportation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
